chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“If you fear that you will not rise at the end of the night, or you have an ailment, or cold has afflicted you, then perform salat and pray the Witr in the first part of the night during travel.”

key_terms.آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ: the end portion of the night
key_terms.أَوَّلِ اللَّيْلِ: the first part of the night

ai.seo_question: When may a traveler perform the Witr prayer at the beginning of the night?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal concession regarding the night prayer for a traveler. If a person fears missing the end of the night, or is hindered by illness or cold, he may perform salat and the Witr prayer at the beginning of the night.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1313 - Al-Halabi reported from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) who said:

"If you fear that you will not be able to wake up at the end of the night, or if you have an ailment or are afflicted by cold, then pray and perform the Witr prayer at the beginning of the night while traveling."
